property_summary: After any single successful airDrop call by any caller, the tokenBalance of that caller increases by 20 and remains callable subsequently (i.e., airDrop does not permanently block future calls for other callers); the mutant that never resets the reentrancy lock can permanently block future airDrop calls and thus can make tokenBalance observations diverge.
change_summary: Changed the reentrancy guard to not reset _locked to false after function execution, causing future calls to be blocked and potentially changing balances observed after subsequent calls.
